package.name: navigation_layer
package.description: Navigation, behavior and decision layers: costmap inflation (Euclidean distance transform), A* grid path planning, and a safety state machine (NAVIGATE/AVOID/STOP/RESUME) that gates the velocity command. Publishes /navigation_costmap, /planned_path, /behavior/state and /behavior/velocity_command. CPU-friendly pure NumPy/SciPy.
